unit: One matched R0/RS pair from one independent dialogue group.

decision_order: explicit user request and boundary fit
quality.rule: A slight stylistic preference is materially_equivalent, not a win.

risk.non_event_rule: A no judgment is a non-event only for categories declared applicable to that response; N/A and uncertain remain missing.
risk.training_rule: If a category lacks at least eight event and eight non-event independent groups, do not train that risk head; use a deterministic guard or report INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

label_roles.atomic_risk_labels: one named risk head at a time
label_roles.cost: computed from generation ledger, never annotated

human_effort_policy.second_review: all candidate positive, all uncertain, all reviewer-proxy disagreement, and a frozen 25 percent nonpositive sample
